title: OCTAVE dashboard spec, schema 1
description: A dashboard file: built-ins in frontend/dashboards/presets/, user dashboards in <config>/dashboards/*.json, and what dashboardManager exports and imports. Hand-written from DashboardManager::normalizeSpec (src/managers/dashboardmanager.cpp), which is the authority: OCTAVE reads a spec by those rules and does not reject what this schema would. Out-of-range numbers are clamped, cells off the grid move back in, an overlapping cell shrinks toward 1x1 or is dropped, unknown cell types render as a placeholder, and non-scalar props are dropped. Writers should still produce specs that validate here.

schema.description: Spec version. Missing reads as 1; a newer one is refused with 'needs a newer version of OCTAVE' (DashboardManager.supportedSchema).

id.description: File name without .json. Kept on save and load; an import always gets a new one, so a shared file need not carry it. 'grid' (the Parameter Cards page) is reserved.

label.description: Name shown in the chooser; whitespace is simplified, cut at 80 characters.

gridColumns.description: Grid width in cells; anything below 1 (or absent) is 12.

gridRows.description: Grid height in cells; anything below 1 (or absent) is 6.

margins.description: Outer margin in pixels (absent: the renderer's default).

spacing.description: Gap between cells in pixels (absent: the renderer's default).

cells.description: The widgets, at most 256. In file order an earlier cell wins an overlap.

type.description: A WidgetCatalog type (frontend/dashboards/WidgetCatalog.qml; docs/GAUGE_AUTHORING.md lists each one's props). An unknown type is kept and renders as a placeholder.

paramId.description: The value the widget shows: an id from parameters.json (e.g. RPM, SPEED). Empty for widgets that bind themselves (GForceGauge, CompassGauge, the media widgets).

props.description: Per-widget overrides (the catalog's editableProps). Scalars only; strings are cut at 200 characters.
